root_cause: Type confusion between a byte-granularity source iterator (uint8_t*) with a byte-count length and an element-granularity destination iterator (T*) passed to std::copy, causing the loop trip count (computed as last-first in the source's element type) to be interpreted as T-sized elements against the destination, over-writing the destination buffer by sizeof(T)x.
findings: In StableWasmArrayObjectElements::StableWasmArrayObjectElements(), when a WasmArrayObject stores its data inline, the code copies the inline array data into a heap Vector sized to hold exactly numElements_ elements of type T.
